title: Free Community Yoga at LA State Historic Park
description: Join us for free, beginner-friendly yoga at LA State Historic Park.
long_description:
Join us for free, beginner-friendly yoga at LA State Historic Park.

About this Event

Take a break, get moving, and enjoy an evening of yoga in the park. This free, beginner-friendly class is open to all experience levels, whether you're brand new to yoga or have an established practice.
Please bring your own yoga mat, or reserve one in advance if you need one.
When:
1st and 3rd Wednesdays at 5:00 PM
Beginning August 5, 2026
Where:
LA State Historic Park
Meet on the small lawn north of the Welcome Pavilion
1315 N Spring St
Los Angeles, CA 90012
What to Bring:
• Yoga mat (or reserve one ahead of time)
• Water
• Comfortable clothing suitable for movement
